thread:
sarah_cs: Quick heads-up — BetaCo finished the sandbox-to-prod cutover and we started getting sporadic 429s on their embed/init calls ~15m after traffic switched. They see bursts for ~30s, then it clears. Impacting 3 customers in the test group.

jules_sdk: Can you paste a sample of the client error and any server-side rate headers?

sarah_cs: Client log snippet: `{"error":"rate_limited","code":429,"retry_after":null}`. No `retry-after` visible. Server side shows `x-req-id` traces and these entries: `2026-03-21T15:02:14Z WARN auth: throttled for ip=34.80.12.45 route=/v1/sdk/init` repeated ~40x.

dan_platform: Do we know if they're using a pool of ephemeral IPs (k8s nat gateway) or a single static IP? That pattern (burst, pause, clear) smells like connection churn + per-ip token window.

mike_infra: BetaCo reported they scaled their frontend pods and are using cloud NAT (ephemeral egress). If many short-lived conns hit the preflight/backoff gate we can see short spikes.

jules_sdk: Ask BetaCo to confirm their SDK config — are they creating a new client per request? Common anti-pattern. Example bad: `for (r of reqs) { new RedwoodClient(apiKey).embed(...) }` — that will open new TLS connections repeatedly. Recommend reusing client instance and enabling keep-alive.

sarah_cs: Here's the snippet they shared from their React edge worker: `const client = new RedwoodClient({ key: process.env.RW_KEY, retries: 1 }); export default async function run(){ await client.init(); /* called on every request */ }` They were calling init per request to re-auth the session.

jules_sdk: That's the issue. Suggest: 1) instantiate client once (module scope) 2) set `maxConcurrent: 6` and `keepAlive: true` 3) use exponential jitter backoff. Example recommended Node config: ```js
// module scope
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY, keepAlive: true, maxConcurrentRequests: 6, backoff: { baseMs: 200, maxMs: 5000, jitter: true } });
export default client;
```

dan_platform: I'll temporarily bump BetaCo's per-tenant short-window burst allowance to avoid user-facing failures while they roll the fix. Mike — can we do a 10m override on tenant betaco-01?

mike_infra: I can add a 10m policy: `tenant:betaco-01 window:30s burst:+150` — applying now. Deploy-bot: rate-policy updated for tenant betaco-01 by mike_infra at 2026-03-21T15:08:10Z.

sarah_cs: BetaCo applied the client change (module-scoped instance + keepAlive) and verified locally — told them to redeploy in ~5–10m.

jules_sdk: Also ask them to surface `x-rw-rate` headers in client logs so we can see remaining tokens during the next window. Quick note: if they still use a shared NAT with many other tenants we may need to advise them on egress IP affinity or use dedicated egress.

sarah_cs: After deploy — they reported errors dropped to ~1/min. Monitor window looks clean now. Sending data to account team for renewal health check.

dan_platform: Follow-up items: - Add quick doc blurb in onboarding checklist about client instance reuse and keepalive - Instrument `x-rw-rate` headers in our onboarding guide - Consider adding a diagnostic flag in SDK that emits rate header metrics to logs

mike_infra: I'll schedule a short post-mortem note summarizing infra changes and the temporary policy override.

sarah_cs: Thanks all — I'll close this thread after the 24h health-check. :thumbsup:
